question: Does the Start Free Plan step on https://rapidapi.com/meteostat/api/meteostat/pricing ask a signed-in account with no card on file for a payment method?
why: The Hub's code shows the dialog text 'No need to add any payment method' for a plan of pricing type FREE, and the Basic plan has that type. Rapid's docs say a Freemium API needs a credit card even for its free plan, and the Hub lists this API as FREEMIUM. Only a signed-in subscription shows which one the live flow follows: behind a sign-up.
